Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, extended lead to 5 Lengths middle stages, led same 5 Lengths turning, kept going in straight. Ran them off their feet. (Winkers AGAIN) [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages. Rider stated he was instructed to let it travel freely as the stable advised it had a breathing issue. After encouraging it early it raced keenly and he allowed it to stride forward in an attempt to allow it to travel comfortably. Stewards questioned trainer re improved performance. Trainer confirmed instructions and added the addition of winkers with it travelling at a high cruising speed and rhythm to assist its breathing, along with a slight drop in grade, contributed to the improved performance. Comments noted.] # led/blew them away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen in middle stages. Rdr stated instructed to let mare travel freely, as stable advised has a breathing issue-said after encouraging mount early, mare raced keenly, so allowed to stride to attempt for mare to travel comfortably. When asked about seemingly improved performance, Tnr confirmed instructs & explained at most recent starts mare had not been performing up to expectations & attributed this to the breathing issues-added with addition of winkers & mare allowed to travel freely, along with a slight drop back in grade, felt these factors attributed to improved performance.
